# Konstruction Group Inc

> Detailed version: https://konstruction.ca/llms-full.txt

> Konstruction Group Inc is a Toronto-based construction company (est. 2011) specializing in framing, structural steel, insulation, and drywall for residential and commercial projects across the Greater Toronto Area. Licensed, WSIB-covered, and carrying $10M liability insurance, we serve general contractors, builders, and homeowners as a reliable multi-trade subcontractor.

- Phone: (416) 901-6020
- Email: info@konstruction.ca
- Address: 410-1315 Lawrence Ave East, Toronto, ON M3A 3R3

Key differentiators: Licensed and bonded, WSIB covered, $10M liability insurance, 1-year workmanship warranty, 15+ years experience, 500+ projects completed, three trades (framing, insulation, drywall) under one contract.

Service areas — Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, Scarborough, North York, Etobicoke, Richmond Hill, plus Toronto and surrounding municipalities.
